name: after-rain-patio
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Match the supplied approved Chinese preschool picture-book reference precisely: premium warm watercolor/gouache with fine layered paper/collage brush texture, honey ochre yellow, muted sage, terracotta, ivory, gentle coherent natural light and richly observed small details, friendly anatomy. Highest available actual native resolution and detail. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, borders, watermark or 3D plastic. NEW square 1:1 cottage patio within exact same garden world AFTER RAIN has stopped. Teal cottage window/door and jasmine vines at back, pale warm stone paving in foreground with a few shallow rain glints near edges, distant grey cloud opening to soft blue and sunshine. A low solid stone garden bench at RIGHT upper-midground only, foreground paving clear for child to sit/draw and chase paper. Gentle breeze bends a few leaves, no flying loose objects. No people, animals, paper, pencils or tools baked in. Rich warm watercolor gouache full bleed to every edge, no ivory fade.
